dedupe_keys.name: upply open data on global seaports and airports

description: Upply Open Data provides standardised reference datasets on transport and logistics nodes, currently global seaports and airports, with 3,528 entries from more than 200 countries. The seaport dataset gives for each port the UN/LOCODE, name, country, a regional zone code based on standard sea areas (for example AS-NCN or EU-NEU) and latitude and longitude, harmonised from several sources by the logistics company Upply. Coverage is global. Access: free CSV and XLSX files, delivered by email from the dataset pages, under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, crediting Upply; the page says the data are updated regularly. Caveats: the files hold locations and codes only, with no capacity, throughput or asset attributes, and the sources merged are not listed. It supports building maritime and air network nodes for flow and supply chain models, geocoding port and airport records and linking datasets by UN/LOCODE, and complements the UNCTADstat maritime statistics and OurAirports records catalogued here.
